gen-flavors-gf-mukta: Whimsical and a bit bossy, Flavors runs one stroke width through every letter, diagonals included. And Mukta, a sans-serif with a lofty small-letter body, settles the page down beside it.
gen-flavors-gf-mukta-mahee: Wire-bent curves that never thin at the spine give Flavors its look, and its diagonals carry as much heft as its stems. Flavors performs, while Mukta Mahee, a chunky sans, handles the quiet reading.
gen-flavors-gf-narnoor: Marker-nib swagger: Flavors draws every line with the same blunt confidence, whatever direction it travels. And Narnoor's short ascenders above big bowls keep a sans-serif paragraph moving smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display fills every word with a big middle zone, a sans-serif that sits quietly under Flavors' blunt round-tip marker feel. Paragraphs would move along easily and without fuss.
gen-flavors-gf-ramabhadra: Flavors has a ruler-and-compass precision to its line, with diagonals carrying the heft of its stems. Ramabhadra and its prominent x-height feel like a much quieter sibling.
gen-flavors-gf-recursive: Recursive is a sans with an approachable, modern build, its strokes holding steady in every direction. And Flavors echoes it, its diagonals as hefty as its stems, which is what ties them together.
gen-flavors-gf-roboto-condensed: A towering x-height, like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, gives Flavors its whimsical, commanding look. Roboto Condensed does the opposite job, gliding along like wire with barely visible gaps inside each word.
gen-flavors-gf-smooch-sans: Whimsical from the first glyph, Flavors draws up strokes and side strokes with no visible difference between them. Smooch Sans follows, packing its line tightly around a high midline.
gen-flavors-gf-spline-sans-mono: Flavors arrives whimsical and commanding, with diagonals as hefty as stems. Spline Sans Mono, a monospace with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, gives paragraphs a technical, typewriter-like march.
gen-flavors-gf-tiny5: Friendly and clean on the page, the body here has ascenders that look short because the letters run so large. Tiny5 stays modest while Flavors does the whimsical, commanding shouting.
